name: British Localities, Counties and Nations
description: What may stand between the thoroughfare and the postcode: a dependent locality and a double dependent locality, a county in full or short (Royal Mail no longer needs it, and it is never the post town), and the country or a nation written at the end. Original cases written for this corpus from Royal Mail's addressing rules, described in our own words; nothing copied.
